title: Liabilities
subtitle: Equity and intercompany current accounts, with balances derived from allocated transactions.

equity.title: New equity position
equity.description: Equity issued by the current organization. The position becomes an allocatable target in the Reconciliation tab.
equity.ownershipHint: This company's cap table is the truth: the equity deal on the holder's side reads this percentage instead of re-entering it.

loan.title: New current account
loan.description: A current account this organization owes to another of the group. Its balance is derived from the transactions allocated to it. An advance it grants is recorded the other way round: as a current-account deal on the borrowing company.

debt.title: New bank loan
debt.description: The contract terms. The schedule and the outstanding capital are computed — never entered.
debt.revolvingHint: A revolving credit has neither duration nor schedule: the drawn amount is entered and corrected by hand.

errors.failed: The action failed. Please try again.
errors.already_matched_to_deal: This transaction is already matched to a deal. Unmatch it first.
errors.invalid_amount: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.ambiguous_holder: Pick either an organization or a free-text label, not both.
errors.same_org: The creditor and the debtor must be two different organizations.
errors.not_a_party: You must be a member of at least one of the two organizations of the current account.
errors.has_allocations: Transactions are still allocated to this line. Detach them first.
errors.missing_duration: An amortizing loan needs a duration.
errors.deferral_too_long: The deferral must be shorter than the loan duration.
errors.limit_below_outstanding: The ceiling cannot be below the drawn amount.
errors.account_wrong_org: This bank account belongs to another organization.
errors.rate_is_fixed: This loan has a fixed rate: there is no revision to enter.
errors.has_documents: Documents are still attached to this row. Detach them first.
errors.missing_anchor: This document must be attached to a company, a deal, a loan or a property.
errors.ambiguous_borrower: Choose either a group loan or an outside borrower, not both.
errors.ambiguous_pledgor: Choose either a group company or a free-text label, not both.
errors.invalid_rank: The rank must be at least 1.
errors.property_wrong_org: This property belongs to another organization.
errors.missing_category: Pick the nature of the flow for a property.
errors.invalid_ownership: The ownership share must be between 0 and 100.
errors.revolving_not_amendable: A revolving credit has no schedule to segment: correct its terms instead.
errors.amendment_before_start: An amendment must take effect after the first instalment. Before that, it is a correction.

loan.title: Edit current account
loan.description: The creditor and debtor cannot be changed — delete and recreate the account instead.

debt.title: Correct the loan
debt.description: Correcting overwrites the terms and recomputes the whole schedule. For a variable-rate revision, add a rate step instead.

delete.confirmBody: Deletion is refused while transactions are still allocated to it — detach them first.
delete.debtConfirmBody: Deletion is refused while documents or transactions are still attached — detach them first.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.empty: The terms entered cannot produce a schedule.
schedule.revolvingBody: A revolving credit has no schedule: only the interest on the drawn amount is projected.
schedule.insuranceNote: Insurance sits outside the instalment: the actual direct debit is instalment + insurance.
schedule.matchedHint: The actual includes the insurance: it does not equal the planned instalment, and that is expected.
schedule.attributionNote: An actual is placed on the instalment whose period it falls in — a calendar attribution, not a proposal. Matching a transaction to this loan happens in the matching queue.

rates.title: Rate
rates.empty: No revision entered — the rate at signature applies.
rates.dialogDescription: A revision that happened, or a steering assumption. Instalments past the last actual revision are flagged as projected.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.empty: No transaction matched to this loan.

amendments.title: Amendments
amendments.hint: the terms changed along the way — the history is kept
amendments.dialogDescription: An amendment keeps the history: the instalments already run do not move, and the new terms apply to the capital that remains. To fix a typo, use « Correct » instead.
amendments.outstandingLabel: Capital outstanding at the effective date
amendments.outstandingHint: Only fill this in if the lender restated it: otherwise the app derives it from the schedule.
amendments.emptyMeansUnchanged: A field left empty stays unchanged.

guarantees.title: Guarantees
guarantees.unquantifiedNote_one: {{count}} guarantee not quantified, excluded from the total.
guarantees.unquantifiedNote_other: {{count}} guarantees not quantified, excluded from the total.
guarantees.negativeMargin: The pledged amount exceeds the asset's value.
guarantees.sortNote: Ordered strongest first — a display convention, not a legal truth: a second rank is only worth what is left.

given.title: Guarantees given
given.subtitle: assets pledged for a third party

onDeal.title: Pledges on this contract
onDeal.noValue: This contract has no valuation: the available margin cannot be computed.

dialog.description: Three independent pieces of information: the form of the security, the asset it bites on, and who commits.
dialog.amountHint: Leave empty for an unquantified guarantee (unlimited surety). It will be excluded from the total and listed apart.

guarantees.deleteConfirmBody: Deleting erases the row. For a guarantee that has ended, prefer the release: it keeps the history.
